interpretation_en: you will feel the effect of envy and hatred

cite.original: If one stings you, you will feel the effect of envy and hatred.
cite.translation_ko: 말벌에 쏘이는 꿈은, 질투와 미움을 느낄 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 적을 억누르고 담대하게 제 권리를 지킬 조짐
interpretation_en: you will be able to throttle your enemies, and fearlessly maintain your rights

cite.original:
To kill them, you will be able to throttle your enemies,
and fearlessly maintain your rights.
cite.translation_ko: 말벌을 죽이는 꿈은, 적을 억누르고 담대하게 제 권리를 지킬 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 밝던 성공의 전망이 의심과 실패로 바뀔 조짐
interpretation_en: foreshadows doubt and failure, where promise of success was bright before you

cite.original:
To dream of wandering through waste places, foreshadows doubt and failure,
where promise of success was bright before you.
cite.translation_ko: 황무지를 헤매는 꿈은, 밝던 성공의 전망이 의심과 실패로 바뀔 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes you will be unpleasantly encumbered with domestic cares

cite.original:
To dream of wasting your fortune, denotes you will be unpleasantly
encumbered with domestic cares.
cite.translation_ko: 재물을 낭비하는 꿈은, 가정의 근심에 불쾌하게 얽매일 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes you will be prosperous in well-directed speculations

cite.original:
To dream of a watch, denotes you will be prosperous in
well-directed speculations.
cite.translation_ko: 시계 꿈은, 잘 짜인 투기로 번창할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: your efforts will be defeated by rivalry

cite.original:
To look at the time of one,
your efforts will be defeated by rivalry.
cite.translation_ko: 시계를 봐서 시간을 확인하는 꿈은, 경쟁으로 애쓴 일이 꺾일 조짐이다

interpretation_en: there will be distress and loss menacing you

cite.original:
To break one,
there will be distress and loss menacing you.
cite.translation_ko: 시계를 깨뜨리는 꿈은, 고통과 손실이 닥칠 조짐이다

cite.original:
To drop the crystal of one, foretells carelessness,
or unpleasant companionship.
cite.translation_ko: 시계 유리를 떨어뜨리는 꿈은, 부주의나 불쾌한 사귐을 예고하는 조짐이다

interpretation_en: signifies domestic disturbances will produce unhappiness

cite.original:
For a woman to lose one,
signifies domestic disturbances will produce unhappiness.
cite.translation_ko: 여자가 시계를 잃어버리는 꿈은, 가정의 다툼으로 불행해질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 제 평판을 공격할 사나운 적이 있을 조짐
interpretation_en: you will have a violent enemy who will attack your reputation

cite.original:
To imagine you steal one, you will have a violent enemy who will
attack your reputation.
cite.translation_ko: 시계를 훔치는 상상을 하는 꿈은, 제 평판을 공격할 사나운 적이 있을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 품위 없는 오락을 좇느라 관심이 시들해질 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes you will suffer your interest to decline in the pursuance of undignified recreations

cite.original:
To make a present of one, denotes you will suffer your interest
to decline in the pursuance of undignified recreations.
cite.translation_ko: 시계를 선물하는 꿈은, 품위 없는 오락을 좇느라 관심이 시들해질 조짐이다
